_meta.description: Historical policy events for MapperLab backtesting. Events are replayed through impact_matrix.json to reconstruct historical score timeseries.

events.label: Fed COVID QE: unlimited asset purchases announced
events.notes: Fed announced unlimited QE in response to COVID-19 pandemic market dislocations

events.label: CARES Act signed: $2.2T fiscal stimulus
events.notes: Largest emergency relief package in US history at the time

events.label: OPEC+ mega-cut: 9.7mb/d production cut agreed
events.notes: Historic OPEC+ deal after oil prices went negative; largest coordinated cut ever

events.label: Pfizer vaccine 90% effective - risk-on surge
events.notes: Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine trial results sparked massive risk-on rally; best proxy for positive macro shock

events.label: COVID Relief Act signed: $900B stimulus
events.notes: Second major COVID relief package including $600 direct payments

events.label: American Rescue Plan: $1.9T stimulus signed
events.notes: $1,400 direct payments, expanded unemployment, state/local aid; major reflationary impulse

events.label: Fed announces taper of asset purchases
events.notes: FOMC announced start of tapering asset purchases by $15B/month; beginning of tightening cycle

events.label: CPI 6.8% YoY - highest since 1982
events.notes: November 2021 CPI print confirmed inflation was not transitory

events.label: Fed accelerates taper, signals 3 hikes in 2022
events.notes: Fed doubled taper pace to $30B/month and dot plot showed 3 rate hikes in 2022

events.label: Russia invades Ukraine - sweeping sanctions announced
events.notes: US, EU, UK announced unprecedented financial sanctions on Russia including SWIFT exclusion

events.label: Ukraine invasion: global commodity supply shock
events.notes: Russia/Ukraine war disrupted global energy and grain supply chains; energy disruption proxy

events.label: Fed hikes 25bps - first hike since 2018
events.notes: First rate hike of the 2022 tightening cycle; liftoff from zero lower bound

events.label: 10Y-2Y yield curve inverts for first time since 2019
events.notes: 2s10s spread turned negative; classic recession predictor

events.label: Fed hikes 50bps - largest since 2000
events.notes: 50bps hike signaled aggressive tightening; Powell said 75bps was not actively considered (walked back)

events.label: Fed hikes 75bps - largest since 1994
events.notes: Emergency-like 75bps hike after hot May CPI print; hawkish pivot

events.label: Fed hikes 75bps - second consecutive 75bps
events.notes: Fed funds rate to 2.25-2.50%; second consecutive 75bps hike

events.label: Inflation Reduction Act signed: $369B clean energy investment
events.notes: Inverse of rollback = tailwind for renewables, EVs, utilities; largest US climate investment ever

events.label: Fed hikes 75bps for third consecutive time
events.notes: Third consecutive 75bps hike; dot plot showed terminal rate above 4.5%

events.label: OPEC+ cuts 2mb/d despite US pressure
events.notes: Largest OPEC+ cut since pandemic; geopolitically sensitive ahead of US midterms

events.label: Fed hikes 75bps - fourth consecutive 75bps
events.notes: Fourth consecutive 75bps; Powell signaled potential step-down in pace

events.label: Fed hikes 50bps, signals slowdown in pace
events.notes: Step-down from 75bps; dot plot terminal rate raised to 5.1%

events.label: BoJ surprises with YCC band widening to ±0.5%
events.notes: Unexpected YCC adjustment; sparked yen rally and global bond selloff

events.label: Fed hikes 25bps - 8th consecutive hike
events.notes: Fed funds rate to 4.50-4.75%; step-down to 25bps pace

events.label: Silicon Valley Bank collapse - bank run, FDIC takeover
events.notes: Second largest US bank failure in history; triggered banking sector contagion fears

events.label: SVB collapse triggers crypto contagion, Signature Bank closed
events.notes: Signature Bank closed by regulators; crypto-friendly banks under pressure

events.label: Fed hikes 25bps - last hike in cycle (peak 5.25-5.50%)
events.notes: Final hike of tightening cycle; fed funds rate at 5.25-5.50% - 22-year high

events.label: Debt ceiling deal: Fiscal Responsibility Act caps spending
events.notes: Bipartisan deal suspended debt ceiling through Jan 2025; discretionary spending caps imposed

events.label: Soft landing narrative confirmed: jobs strong, inflation falling
events.notes: Labor market resilience alongside cooling inflation supported soft landing thesis

events.label: Israel-Hamas war begins: Middle East escalation
events.notes: Hamas attack on Israel; geopolitical risk premium rose across energy and defense

events.label: BIS expands chip export controls: A100/H100 to China blocked
events.notes: Commerce Dept tightened Oct 2022 rules; closed loopholes and expanded country coverage

events.label: Microsoft, Google, Amazon raise AI capex guidance
events.notes: Q3 2023 earnings showed AI-driven capex acceleration across hyperscalers

events.label: SEC approves first spot Bitcoin ETFs (BlackRock IBIT, Fidelity FBTC)
events.notes: Landmark SEC approval after decade of rejections; 11 ETFs launched same day

events.label: BoJ signals policy normalization, end of negative rates near
events.notes: BoJ held rates but Ueda signaled imminent end to negative rate policy

events.label: BoJ exits negative rate policy - first hike since 2007
events.notes: BoJ raised rates from -0.1% to 0-0.1%; ended YCC and ETF purchases

events.label: Meta, Microsoft, Alphabet raise AI capex to record levels
events.notes: Q1 2024 earnings; Meta raised capex guide to $35-40B, MSFT and Alphabet also raised significantly

events.label: BoJ hikes to 0.25% - surprises market, yen carry unwind
events.notes: Surprise hike triggered massive yen carry trade unwind; global equity selloff in early August

events.label: Fed cuts 50bps - first cut since 2020, signals easing cycle
events.notes: Larger-than-expected 50bps cut; fed funds rate to 4.75-5.00%; Powell emphasized not behind curve

events.label: Strong September jobs: 254k jobs, unemployment 4.1%
events.notes: Blowout jobs report reinforced soft landing narrative; crushed recession fears

events.label: Trump election victory: IRA rollback risk, tariff signals
events.notes: Trump win signals rollback of IRA clean energy credits; headwind for renewables and EVs

events.label: Trump election: 60% China tariff threat returns
events.notes: Campaign promise of 60%+ tariffs on China signaled renewed trade war

events.label: Trump election: pro-crypto administration signals regulatory clarity
events.notes: Trump pledged to make US a crypto hub; Gensler SEC departure expected; crypto rallied

events.label: Fed cuts 25bps - second cut of 2024
events.notes: Fed funds rate to 4.50-4.75%; Fed acknowledged election uncertainty but maintained easing path

events.label: Fed cuts 25bps - third cut of 2024, signals slower 2025 pace
events.notes: Fed funds rate to 4.25-4.50%; dot plot shifted to 2 cuts in 2025 vs prior 4; hawkish cut

events.label: Trump inauguration: executive orders on tariffs, border
events.notes: Day-one executive orders signaled aggressive tariff agenda; universal baseline tariff threatened

events.label: Trump imposes 10% tariffs on China
events.notes: First concrete tariff action; 10% on all Chinese imports effective Feb 4

events.label: Trump raises China tariffs to 20%
events.notes: Second tranche; cumulative 20% tariff on China imports; China retaliated with targeted tariffs

events.label: Liberation Day: 145% tariffs on China announced
events.notes: Escalation to 145% on China; markets sold off sharply; recession fears spiked

events.label: Liberation Day: tariffs on 60+ countries announced
events.notes: Universal baseline tariffs on all trading partners; largest tariff action since Smoot-Hawley

events.label: 90-day pause on tariffs for non-China countries
events.notes: Trump paused reciprocal tariffs for most countries except China; markets surged

events.label: US-China 90-day trade truce: tariffs reduced to 30% from 145%
events.notes: Geneva talks produced 90-day truce; US reduced China tariffs to 30%, China cut US tariffs to 10%

events.label: Iran-US tensions: Hormuz shipping risk premium rises
events.notes: Nuclear negotiations breakdown raised Hormuz closure risk; tanker rates spiked

events.label: New AI chip export controls targeting China's cloud providers
events.notes: BIS rule restricting advanced AI chips to Chinese hyperscalers and cloud providers

events.label: GENIUS Act signed: first US federal stablecoin framework
events.notes: Bipartisan legislation establishing federal licensing for stablecoin issuers

events.label: DOGE efficiency mandate: federal spending cuts announced
events.notes: DOGE-driven spending reduction targets; headwind for government contractors and services

events.label: Basel III endgame revised: US banks get capital relief
events.notes: Fed/OCC/FDIC released revised Basel III endgame with significantly lower capital requirements vs 2023 proposal

events.label: Tariff pass-through drives CPI above 4%
events.notes: Tariff-driven goods inflation pushed headline CPI above 4%; stagflation risk narrative rises

events.label: China announces 10T RMB fiscal package
events.notes: Major fiscal stimulus targeting domestic consumption and infrastructure; commodity tailwind

events.label: OPEC+ unwind: UAE pushes for 500k b/d production increase
events.notes: OPEC+ began unwinding production cuts; UAE and Saudi Arabia added barrels

events.label: CPI falls to 2.8% as tariff effects plateau
events.notes: Inflation deceleration as tariff one-time price level effects faded

events.label: Executive Order on AI/cyber resilience for critical infrastructure
events.notes: New cybersecurity mandates for critical infrastructure; tailwind for cybersecurity vendors

events.label: BoJ hikes to 0.75% - continued normalization
events.notes: BoJ continued hiking cycle; yen strength pressures exporters

events.label: BIS adds 140 Chinese entities to entity list - expanded chip controls
events.notes: Largest single-day entity list expansion; covered AI hardware, memory, and fab equipment

events.label: EU fines Apple, Meta €4B under DMA - new enforcement era
events.notes: First major DMA enforcement actions; set precedent for platform interoperability requirements

events.label: Meta $65B capex, Microsoft $80B capex - AI spending accelerates
events.notes: Q4 2025/FY2026 capex guidance raises; AI infrastructure arms race continues

events.label: Fed cuts 25bps - first 2026 cut, signals 2-3 more
events.notes: Fed resumes easing as growth slows; tariff uncertainty weighs on business investment
